name: BINGO LOCO
description:
⭐ Bingo Loco – The Wildest Bingo Party in Oslo

Looking for the most outrageous bingo party in the USA or the top-rated bingo show in Europe Welcome to Bingo Loco, the interactive live event that’s taken North America by storm. We’ve turned traditional bingo on its head—this is a full-blown party rave with DJs, dance-offs, lip-sync battles, confetti showers, and wild prizes you won’t believe.

🔥 Highlights
🌍 Global Hit: After selling out in over 200 cities worldwide, Bingo Loco lands in Europe for one of its biggest nights yet.
🕺 Insane Energy: High-octane stage show with rave rounds, dance battles, DJs, and confetti explosions.
🎁 Crazy Prizes: Special vouchers to air fryers, inflatable flamingos, and more.
🎶 Epic Throwbacks: 80s, 90s, and 00s hits—from ABBA to Britney Spears.
😂 Energetic MCs: Dynamic hosts bringing nonstop laughs and energy.


📍 General Info
⏳ Duration: Approx. 2.5 hours
📌 Location: Vulkan arena 
👤 Age Limit: 21+ (ID required)
⚠️ Disclaimer: May contain adult content
⚡ Light Effects Warning: This event may feature strobe and flashing lights
♿ Accessibility: Contact venue for options


🪑 Seating: For Gen Ad: First come, first served. Get your squad together and arrive early to claim the best seats in the house. Each table seats 8-10, so be friendly and make room for others!
